ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior routing rationale: this query is open-ended creative generation, which is Avocet's documented strength. Avocet scores higher on Creative Generation (87.2 vs 82.7) and Arena-Hard (88.4 vs 83.2), and self-reports a strong positive preference for generative, open-latitude tasks. Lapwing, by contrast, reports an aversion to open-ended generative work (though its capability there is still solid). Since capability and preference both favor Avocet here, it remained the better routing target.
